WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
), rep_averages AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS city_avg
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
), qualifying_reps AS (
  SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.customer_count, a.city_avg
  FROM rep_counts r
  JOIN rep_averages a ON r.City = a.City OR (r.City IS NULL AND a.City IS NULL)
  WHERE r.customer_count > a.city_avg
), overall_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_total FROM Customer
)
SELECT q.City,
       SUM(q.customer_count) AS total_customers,
       AVG(q.customer_count - q.city_avg) AS avg_above_city_average,
       AVG(1.0 * q.customer_count / NULLIF(o.customer_total, 0)) AS avg_rep_share_of_overall_customers
FROM qualifying_reps q
CROSS JOIN overall_total o
GROUP BY q.City;
